IS : 12091-1987 



Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
BELT FASTENERS, HOOK TYPE 



( Reaffirmed 2001 ) 



1 . Scope — Covers the requirements for belt fasteners of hook type used in joining conveyor belting 
where the tensile strength is limited to 630 kN Max. 

1.1 Does not cover alligator or plate type of fasteners. 

2. Dimensions 

2.1 With Steel Wire Hoider ~Sha\\ be as given in Table 1. 

2.2 Witii Card Board H o ide r — ShaW be as given in Table 2. 

3. Material — The fasteners shall be manufactured from carbon steel wire conforming to grade C 35 
of IS : 1 570-1 961 'Schedules for wrought steels for general engineering purposes'. After drawing the 
wire, the ultimate tensile strength shall be 120 to 130 kg/mm^ 

4. Manufacture, Workmanship and Finish — The combs shall be so constructed that the hooks are 
firmly held at the correct distance apart. They shall be made from stiff card board holder or could be 
held by a thin mild steel wire of 1-6 mm diameter. The fasteners shall be free from seams and other 
defects. The points shall be well-formed. The belt fasteners shall be galvanized according to Table 1 
of IS: 4826-1979 'Specification for hot dipped galvanized coatings on round steel wires (first 
revision)'. Alternatively, fasteners shall be electroplated according to Table 3 of IS : 1068-1985 
'Specification for electroplated coatings of nickel plus chromium and copper plus nickel plus 
chromium on iron and steel (second revision)'. Grades and classification of galvanizing and 
electroplating shall be as agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier.

5. Tests — The fasteners shall be subjected to breaking strength test as per IS : 9405-1980 'Method 
of test for mechanical belt fasteners'. Breaking strength shall be as agreed to between the purchaser 
and the supplier. 

6. Selection of Fasteners — Shall be made as per Table 3. 

7. Packaging — The fasteners shall be packed in boxes and before packing, they shall be wrapped in 
grease paper to prevent rusting. 

8. Certification Marking — Details available with the Bureau of Indian Standards.

EXPLANATORYNOTE 

This standard covers the requirements of belt fasteners of hook type used in joining conveyor 
belting. It contains clauses 4 and 5 which require agreements between the supplier and the 
puchaser. Breaking strength is an important parameter and it shall be as agreed to between the 
supplier and the purchaser. 

This standard has been prepared in the light of technical practices followed in India.
